sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:81

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:81:1
items.html:
And the worlds rose in this manner: ZA rose to the place that is now the place of AA, and the Nukva of ZA rose to the place that is now the place of Aba, etc.: It is already brought above that these sortings were from below upward, for the reason that the choicest of all was sorted out first. And therefore, at first ZON sorted out, from the MAN of the Vav and the point, the aspect of the coarseness of phase two, which is the level of Neshama; and therefore it is regarded that the Nukva rose to the place of Ima, and ZA to the place of Aba, and the coupling was made in the place of Ima, which is phase two and Neshama. And know that the level of the coupling is always regarded according to the state of the Nukva, and not according to the state of ZA, because the MAN are in the Nukva, as is known. And afterwards ZON sorted out, from the MAN of the Vav and the point, the coarseness of phase three, which is the level of Haya, which is the second phase that was added in the fifth hour of the sixth day. And it was then regarded that ZA rose to AA, and the Nukva, who is the possessor of the MAN, rose to the place of Aba, namely, to the upper AVI, which are called Aba, for the level of Haya is in the place of the upper AVI, as is known. And it is therefore found that the head of the soul of Adam HaRishon came out in the place of Ima, namely, in the place of YESHSUT, which are called Ima; and the body of the soul, which is Yetzira, rose to the place of ZA.
And the two lower thirds of the Tifferet of the soul, which are the first four of Assiya, rose to the place of the Nukva of ZA; and the legs of the soul, which are the seven lower ones of Assiya, rose to the place of the first six of Beria.
